serviceInputs: Power, robots, and items in the logistics network
notes: Inputs are recipe ingredients and recognized machine fuels or fluids supplied from outside. Outputs are products not consumed by another included process. Check belt, pipe, and robot connections in-game; this analysis does not simulate routing or throughput.

userRuntime.scope: Exact source and candidate I/O, power, lane identities and sustained source-relative output

outputs.kind: Exact-source measured baseline in the same recorded runtime and supply protocol

assumptions.purpose: Paired original-source and module-free candidate route, power and sustained output measurements with exact blueprint hashes.
assumptions.supply: Both lanes of each exterior yellow belt carry only the labeled material. Source belts sit under the original filtered external pickup; candidates receive the same material directly at their new boundary inlet.
assumptions.collection: Drain each original or candidate product chest every tick; no robot supply or internal injection. Sources retain their original interior chest locations.
assumptions.modules: Install exactly the original source module requests in source cases; candidate cases have zero modules.
assumptions.recipeAvailability: Enable exactly the saved recipe names; grant no other research effects.
assumptions.electricity: Unlimited external source connected to one retained pole. Original external feeder arms may also need the exterior pole coverage; no fixture is placed inside a blueprint.
assumptions.laneSampling: Every 60 ticks, inspect both native transport lines of each saved belt; reject any material outside its static lane proof. Include empty lane claims.

gaps: Observed source-relative rates under one supply, collection and inserter-research configuration; not a mathematical maximum.
